title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Sunday, 1 November 2026
description: Apple overtakes Nvidia as the world's most valuable company amid AI capex jitters, the federal government won't appeal a court ruling clearing a stalled NSW gold mine, Queensland's Land Court backs a $1 billion Bowen Basin coal mine, and the Gold Coast Suns narrowly miss AFLW top four despite beating the Giants. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
